sources.title: ReCAAP ISC Annual Report on Piracy and Armed Robbery against Ships in Asia 2023
sources.text: While underway, perpetrators on a wooden boat tried to board the ship using an improvised rope. The ship, maintaining a good anti-piracy watch, detected the wooden boat at approach. The crew immediately informed the master and raised the general alarm. The perpetrators left immediately without boarding.
